name: Trim
description: Quietly removes old tool output your agents no longer need, so every request costs less. Shows what it saved.
author: idayley

helper.name: Judge
helper.about: A small model on your Mac (Qwen3.5-4B) that tells Trim which old output your agent still needs, so it cuts more safely. Setting it up downloads about 9 GB once; while it runs it uses about 2.5 GB of memory.
